page_title: camber: a free, open-source Arc alternative for Mac, Windows and Linux

sources.entry: camber - Open-source Arc-style browser on Chromium (Electron) with spaces, pinned tabs, folders, a command bar and Arc import. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/yuvrajangadsingh/camber) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: camber
summary.one_liner: camber is a free, open-source Chromium-based browser for macOS, Windows and Linux that recreates Arc's sidebar, spaces, pinned tabs and command bar, and can import spaces from Arc.
use_cases: Replacing Arc browser after its end-of-life date
Moving Arc spaces, favorites and pinned tabs to another browser
Using a sidebar-based tab organizer on Linux
Running a privacy-focused browser without an account or telemetry
Reducing browser memory use by unloading idle tabs
summary.what_it_does: camber is a browser with Arc's sidebar, spaces, pinned tabs and command bar, available for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel), Windows and Linux (AppImage and .deb). It can import spaces, profiles, favorites, pinned tabs, folders and today tabs from Arc via File, Import from Arc, or from a copied StorableSidebar.json file. Tabs unused for an hour have their memory released while staying in the sidebar; the page reports a drop from 4.9 GB to 0.85 GB with 23 tabs open on an M5 MacBook Air. It runs on Chromium, so it can install extensions from the Chrome Web Store, and it has no account, telemetry or AI features.
notable: Imports spaces, favorites, pinned tabs and folders from Arc
Unloads tabs idle for an hour to free memory while keeping them in the sidebar
Runs on Chromium and supports Chrome Web Store extensions
Open source under GPL-3.0, with no account or telemetry
caveats: Builds are unsigned, so first launch needs an extra step on macOS and Windows
No Widevine, so Netflix and other DRM video will not play; 1Password does not work yet
No sync, Boosts, Live Folders, or Windows arm64 build; history, passwords, bookmarks, extensions and Easels do not import from Arc
